title: Data-Efficient RLVR via Off-Policy Influence Guidance
authors_zh: Erle Zhu, Dazhi Jiang, Yuan Wang, Xujun Li, Jiale Cheng, Yuxian Gu, Yilin Niu, Aohan Zeng, Jie Tang, Minlie Huang, Hongning Wang
paper_type_zh: 离策略影响引导的 RLVR 数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建目标导向或算力受限的 RLVR 系统，并希望依据当前策略选择数据、却不愿为全提示池重新生成轨迹的读者。
one_line: CROPI uses offline trajectories and projected gradient influence to refresh the 10-percent RLVR subset that receives each stage of GRPO training.
CROPI 用离线轨迹和投影梯度影响分数，持续更新每个阶段实际进入 GRPO 训练的 10% RLVR 提示。
why: It connects a prompt-selection decision to an explicit approximation of its expected contribution to validation objectives, then refreshes that decision during training.
inclusion_reason: It repeatedly chooses which RLVR prompts receive GRPO updates by estimating each prompt's off-policy influence on held-out optimization targets.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLVR needs a policy-dependent way to decide which prompts should consume scarce rollouts and update steps. Difficulty, pass rate, and static quality scores can be useful heuristics, but they do not directly ask whether optimizing one prompt will improve the intended reasoning objective. A direct influence calculation would make that connection, yet it normally requires expensive online rollouts and full high-dimensional gradients for every prompt.

The paper asks whether the contribution of a training prompt can be estimated cheaply enough to drive repeated RLVR data selection. It frames the desired record as one whose policy gradient aligns with gradients for a small selection-validation set. The practical requirement is to refresh that decision as the policy changes, without regenerating a full prompt pool of trajectories at every phase.

RLVR 需要一种依赖当前策略的方式，决定哪些提示值得消耗稀缺的轨迹生成和更新步骤。难度、通过率和静态质量分数可以作为有用的启发式指标，但它们并不直接回答：优化某个提示是否会改进预期的推理目标。直接计算影响函数能建立这种联系，却通常要求为每个提示生成昂贵的在线轨迹，并处理完整的高维梯度。

论文要回答的是，能否以足够低的成本估计训练提示的贡献，从而驱动反复进行的 RLVR 数据选择。它把理想记录定义为：其策略梯度与一个小型选择验证集的梯度相一致。实际要求是在策略变化时刷新这一决定，而不必在每个阶段都为整个提示池重新生成轨迹。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CROPI uses trajectories sampled once from an initial behavior policy to approximate how the current policy would update on every prompt. It then treats the cosine similarity between a prompt's projected off-policy gradient and a validation-set gradient as practical influence. A high score means that optimizing the prompt is estimated to move the policy in a direction that also helps the chosen validation objective.

Selection is deliberately recurrent rather than global. At the start of a phase, the current checkpoint re-scores the entire training pool, ranks prompts for one or more validation sets, fuses those ranks, and retains only the top fraction for GRPO. The next checkpoint changes the influence landscape, so the next phase can choose a different subset without paying for new full-pool rollouts.

CROPI 使用从初始行为策略一次性采样的轨迹，近似当前策略会如何在每个提示上更新。随后，它把一个提示的投影离策略梯度与验证集梯度之间的余弦相似度视为实际影响。高分意味着，优化该提示预计会使策略朝着同样有利于所选验证目标的方向移动。

选择有意采取反复更新而非一次性全局排序。在每个阶段开始时，当前检查点会重新评分整个训练池，分别为一个或多个验证集排序提示，融合这些排序后只保留最高的一部分用于 GRPO。下一个检查点会改变影响分布，因此下一阶段可以选择不同子集，同时不必为完整提示池付出新的轨迹生成成本。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method first stores multiple offline trajectories for each prompt under the initial policy. For the current checkpoint, it estimates an importance-weighted, unclipped GRPO-like gradient from those trajectories. Before comparing gradients, it randomly drops most dimensions and applies sparse random projection; gradient features are normalized, so practical influence is a cosine similarity rather than a length-sensitive norm. Scores from multiple selection-validation sets are combined with reciprocal-rank fusion.

CROPI divides training into phases. In each phase it scores all 47K training prompts, selects the top alpha share—10 percent in the main experiments—and performs GRPO only on that refreshed subset for a fixed number of steps. The validation data consists of up to 20 percent of designated test sets, capped at 100 examples per set; those selection examples are excluded from the reported test results. The training return is deterministic binary answer correctness with group-normalized advantages.

该方法先在初始策略下为每个提示存储多条离线轨迹。对于当前检查点，它从这些轨迹估计一个带重要性权重、未裁剪的类 GRPO 梯度。比较梯度之前，它会随机丢弃大部分维度并施加稀疏随机投影；梯度特征经过归一化，所以实际影响是余弦相似度，而不是对长度敏感的范数。来自多个选择验证集的分数用倒数排序融合组合起来。

CROPI 把训练划分为多个阶段。每个阶段都会给全部 4.7 万个训练提示评分，选择最高的 alpha 比例——主要实验中为 10%——仅在这个更新后的子集上进行固定步数的 GRPO。验证数据来自指定测试集最多 20% 的样本，每个集合上限为 100 个；这些用于选择的样本不会进入报告的测试结果。训练回报是确定性的二元答案正确性，并使用组归一化优势。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main table evaluates Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B across GSM8K, MATH, Gaokao, AMC23, OlympiadBench, and AIME24. In the 1.5B setting at 1,000 steps, CROPI reports a 70.26 targeted-task average and 29.60 untargeted-task average, compared with 69.42 and 27.06 for full-data GRPO. The paper reports a 2.66-times step-level acceleration on targeted tasks while selecting 10 percent of the pool per phase.

The authors also include the cost of selection rather than reporting only optimization steps. On the 1.5B setup, each phase lists 1.2 hours for selection over 19K processed prompts and 5.2 hours for 200 training steps on eight H100 GPUs; after selection cost, the paper reports an overall 2.16-times speedup and a 2.17-times speedup to 70 percent targeted accuracy. Ablations compare random phase-wise selection and projected-gradient settings, while the evaluation excludes examples used to construct the selection-validation sets.

主表在 GSM8K、MATH、高考、AMC23、OlympiadBench 和 AIME24 上评测了 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B。在 1.5B、1,000 步设置下，CROPI 报告目标任务平均分为 70.26、非目标任务平均分为 29.60；全数据 GRPO 分别为 69.42 和 27.06。论文报告在每阶段只选择 10% 提示时，目标任务达到 2.66 倍的步数级加速。

作者还计入了选择成本，而不是只报告优化步数。在 1.5B 设置中，每个阶段在 8 张 H100 上，对 1.9 万个被处理提示的选择耗时 1.2 小时，200 步训练耗时 5.2 小时；加入选择成本后，论文报告总体仍有 2.16 倍加速，达到 70% 目标准确率时有 2.17 倍加速。消融比较了逐阶段随机选择和投影梯度设置，评测中排除了用于构造选择验证集的样本。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new decision is to score a training prompt by approximate policy-gradient contribution to an explicit downstream validation objective, rather than by an intrinsic property such as difficulty or pass rate. Offline trajectories make that objective-conditioned score feasible without performing full-pool online rollouts at every selection step. Sparse random projection is not only a storage device here: it is part of the practical ranking mechanism for full-parameter gradients.

The curriculum is also more specific than ordinary easy-to-hard scheduling. It re-evaluates influence after each policy phase and can move the selected set toward prompts that are semantically relevant to the validation objective and near the current learning frontier. This makes the validation set a declared consumer-side preference in the data-selection rule, while preserving a held-out evaluation split for the reported results.

新的决定是依据一个训练提示对明确下游验证目标的近似策略梯度贡献来评分，而不是依据难度或通过率之类的内在属性。离线轨迹使这种依赖目标的分数成为可能，无需在每次选择时都为完整提示池进行在线轨迹生成。稀疏随机投影在这里也不只是存储手段：它是对全参数梯度进行实际排序机制的一部分。

这一课程也比普通的由易到难调度更具体。它在每个策略阶段后重新评估影响，可以把所选集合移向与验证目标在语义上相关、并靠近当前学习边界的提示。这使验证集成为数据选择规则中被明确声明的消费者侧偏好，同时仍保留了独立的评测划分用于报告结果。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The influence approximation is first-order, assumes the SGD setting in the analysis, and lacks a formal error, bias, or variance bound for off-policy gradients. Trajectories come only from the base policy, so prompts with uniformly correct or incorrect base-policy outcomes can have zero GRPO gradient and disappear from the available signal. Although it avoids fresh full-pool rollouts, it still computes gradients over the whole pool every phase, and its evidence is restricted to single-turn mathematics with models no larger than 7B and fewer than 1,000 training steps.
影响近似是一阶的，分析中假设 SGD 设置，并且没有给出离策略梯度误差、偏差或方差的正式界限。轨迹只来自基础策略，因此基础策略结果始终正确或始终错误的提示可能具有零 GRPO 梯度，从可用信号中消失。尽管它避免了新的全池在线轨迹生成，每个阶段仍要为整个池计算梯度；其证据也只限于单轮数学任务、参数不超过 7B 的模型以及少于 1,000 个训练步骤。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CROPI as a design reference when the training objective has a small, well-governed validation target and the system can store offline trajectories. It is useful for choosing an RLVR subset repeatedly, especially when domain relevance matters more than a global notion of data quality. Before reuse, decide whether the selection-validation set represents a legitimate objective rather than a leakage route, audit the offline trajectory provenance, and measure the full gradient-selection cost against the rollout savings in the target stack.
当训练目标拥有一个规模小、治理清晰的验证目标，并且系统能够存储离线轨迹时，可以把 CROPI 作为设计参考。它适合反复选择 RLVR 子集，尤其适用于领域相关性比全局数据质量更重要的情况。复用之前，应判断选择验证集是否代表合法目标而非泄漏通道，审计离线轨迹的来源，并在目标技术栈中比较完整梯度选择成本与节省下来的轨迹生成成本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper from the perspective of the selection contract: the validation set specifies what improvement counts, offline trajectories supply a reusable estimate of each prompt's update direction, and phase-wise ranking determines which records the optimizer actually consumes. Distinguish the reported 2.66-times step-level result from the 2.16-times overall result that includes selection time, and inspect the data split carefully because a targeted objective can be appropriate for training while still narrowing the type of generalization being measured.
阅读这篇论文时，应从选择契约的角度理解：验证集规定什么改进算数，离线轨迹为每个提示提供可复用的更新方向估计，而逐阶段排序决定优化器实际消费哪些记录。要区分 2.66 倍的步数级结果与计入选择时间后的 2.16 倍总体结果，并仔细检查数据划分，因为目标导向的训练目标可以是合理的，却也会缩窄被测量的泛化类型。

Mathematical prompt, offline rollout trajectories, binary correctness return, off-policy policy gradient, sparse projection, validation-set influence rank, and phase-specific top-10-percent inclusion decision.
The initial policy generates offline trajectories for every prompt before training; the evolving policy is optimized on selected prompts.
Multi-stage GRPO RLVR with deterministic final-answer correctness rewards and a small held-out validation set used only for selection.
A deterministic binary final-answer correctness indicator supplies the trajectory return; group-normalized advantage defines the GRPO gradient.
At each phase, only the top alpha fraction of prompts by fused practical off-policy influence to the validation sets enters GRPO updates.
Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B.
No teacher labels; a fixed initial behavior policy supplies offline trajectories.
The behavior policy samples offline trajectories before training; GRPO produces online optimization rollouts only for selected prompts.
At the beginning of every curriculum phase, re-score the whole pool with the current checkpoint, select the top 10 percent, run GRPO for E steps, and repeat.
Multiple offline trajectories per prompt; the exact count varies with the reported GRPO setup.
Not reported as a selection parameter.
Normalize sparse-projected off-policy gradients, score cosine influence against each validation set, fuse rankings with reciprocal-rank fusion, and retain the top alpha share.
The main selection ratio is 10 percent per phase; a 1.5B experiment uses a 47K-prompt pool and the 1.5B-R1 setting samples 25K prompts.
Multi-stage GRPO RLVR with a KL-constrained current policy and sparse random projection of full-parameter gradients.
GSM8K-Train, MATH-Train, and DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset, intersected into 47K unique mathematics queries.
Up to 20 percent of each designated test set, capped at 100 examples per set, forms selection-only validation data; reported test results exclude those validation examples.
The authors exclude selection-validation examples from reported test performance, but do not provide a full upstream-contamination audit.
